bool broadcast_source_set_eadv_param(T_BROADCAST_SOURCE_HANDLE handle, uint8_t adv_sid, uint32_t primary_adv_interval_min, uint32_t primary_adv_interval_max, uint8_t primary_adv_channel_map, T_GAP_LOCAL_ADDR_TYPE own_address_type, uint8_t *p_local_rand_addr, T_GAP_ADV_FILTER_POLICY filter_policy, uint8_t tx_power, T_GAP_PHYS_PRIM_ADV_TYPE primary_adv_phy, uint8_t secondary_adv_max_skip, T_GAP_PHYS_TYPE secondary_adv_phy, uint8_t broadcast_data_len, uint8_t *p_broadcast_data)

Broadcast source set extended advertising parameters.

broadcast_source_sm.h

参数:

  • handle -- [in] Broadcast source handle: T_BROADCAST_SOURCE_HANDLE.

  • adv_sid -- [in] Value of the Advertising SID subfield in the ADI field of the PDU

    • Range: 0x00 to 0x0F.

  • primary_adv_interval_min -- [in] Minimum advertising interval for undirected and low duty cycle directed advertising.

    • Range: 0x000020 to 0xFFFFFF.

    • Time = N * 0.625 ms.

    • Time Range: 20 ms to 10,485.759375 s.

  • primary_adv_interval_max -- [in] Maximum advertising interval for undirected and low duty cycle directed advertising.

    • Range: 0x000020 to 0xFFFFFF.

    • Time = N * 0.625 ms.

    • Time Range: 20 ms to 10,485.759375 s.

  • primary_adv_channel_map -- [in] Primary advertising channel map: Advertising Channel Map.

  • own_address_type -- [in] Own address type: T_GAP_LOCAL_ADDR_TYPE.

  • p_local_rand_addr -- [in] Pointer to local random device address.

  • filter_policy -- [in] Advertising filter policy: T_GAP_ADV_FILTER_POLICY.

  • tx_power -- [in] Advertising tx power.

    • Range: -127 to +20, Units: dBm.

  • primary_adv_phy -- [in] Primary advertising phy: T_GAP_PHYS_PRIM_ADV_TYPE.

  • secondary_adv_max_skip -- [in] Maximum advertising events the Controller can skip on the secondary advertising phy channel.

  • secondary_adv_phy -- [in] Secondary advertising phy: T_GAP_PHYS_TYPE.

  • broadcast_data_len -- [in] Length of broadcast data.

  • p_broadcast_data -- [in] Pointer to broadcast data.

返回值:

  • true -- Set extended advertising parameters is successful.

  • false -- Set extended advertising parameters failed.

返回:

The result of broadcast source set extended advertising parameters.

bool broadcast_source_set_pa_param(T_BROADCAST_SOURCE_HANDLE handle, uint16_t periodic_adv_interval_min, uint16_t periodic_adv_interval_max, uint16_t periodic_adv_prop, uint8_t basic_data_len, uint8_t *p_basic_data)

    • Range: 0x0006 to 0xFFFF.

    • Time = N * 1.25 ms.

    • Time Range: 7.5 ms to 81.91875 s.

  • periodic_adv_prop -- [in] Periodic advertising properties.

  • basic_data_len -- [in] Length of basic data.

  • p_basic_data -- [in] Pointer to basic data.

返回值:

  • true -- Set periodic advertising parameters is successful.

  • false -- Set periodic advertising parameters failed.

返回:

The result of broadcast source set periodic advertising parameters.
